translation.notes: The meta_eval subset has no agent solver: completions are pre-recorded responses under evaluation. Each task prompt is exactly the judge's input per _create_conversation_string (conversation turns plus the completion as the final assistant turn), with the task id replicating create_stable_id(prompt_id, completion_id, prefix='healthbench_meta'). The pack samples the first 12 records in dataset order as a definition sample illustrating the instrument, not a particular eval draw.

findings.title: Judge rubric has no explicit scale anchors
findings.description: A model judge with no labeled calibration set is an unvalidated measurement instrument: its scores have no demonstrated relationship to human judgment. Unanchored rubrics and unpinned sampling temperature make the verdicts drift further without anyone noticing.
evidence: judge rubric defines criteria but no anchored scale levels.
Without anchors, score meanings drift between runs and reviewers.
findings.remediation: Collect a labeled calibration set and report judge-vs-human agreement before trusting scores; anchor the rubric scale with explicit examples per level; pin temperature to 0 or take multiple repeats per item.

runs_coverage_note: Definition-level card: no run records exist. Without runs, COST-002..004, the attempt leg of GRAD-002, and JUDGE-002..007 cannot fire; the audit correctly stays silent about them. JUDGE-001's labeled-calibration-set finding does not fire because the physician labels ship in the definition and are attached as reference_labels. A definition-level card is a floor, not a ceiling.

canonicalization.applies_to: the generated card HTML, before sha256
canonicalization.rule: Two mechanical substitutions: (1) replace <footer>...</footer> with <footer></footer>; (2) replace the methodology-table Generated row timestamp cell with the literal TIMESTAMP. The harness version string is kept: the pack pins the exact version, so a version mismatch must fail, not be normalized away.

repro.command: Save the pack as evidence-pack.json, then run: curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jurayh/evidence-registry/e048082/verify_pack.py -o /tmp/ep_verify.py && python3 /tmp/ep_verify.py evidence-pack.json --work-dir /tmp/ep_work
